title: Google Engineer on His Sentient AI Claim
summary: Bloomberg Technology interviews Google engineer Blake Lemoine about the experiments that led him to believe LaMDA was sentient and why he was placed on administrative leave. He also raises concerns about AI ethics at Google.
why: HN commenters recommend watching it to hear his side directly, noting he comes across as coherent, while others dispute his sincerity.

quote.text: I'd implore anyone reading this thread to see what he had to say for yourself and form your own opinion
